title: On Relaying the order to every boat
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：relay　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 relay 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the foreman ① relayed the order to every boat in public, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② relays the order to every boat in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ relay the order to every boat at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ relayed the order to every boat before — a line in the sheet for May 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Relaying the order to every boat in public, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ relay the water along the whole field in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Relay the water along the whole field at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ relays the water along the whole field in public every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ relayed the order to every boat again when nobody else would.

⑩ To relay the order to every boat, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody relays the order to every boat in silence again and somebody must relay the order to every boat in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 转述（一般过去式 relayed the order to every boat：1989 年工头头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 转述（一般现在 relays the order to every boat：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 转述（不定式 to relay the order to every boat：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 转述（过去完成时 had relayed the order to every boat：1983 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 转述（动名词 relaying the order to every boat 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 接力传送（relay the water along the whole field：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去接力传送让水顺着整块地接力流过）
G. v. 接力传送（relay the water along the whole field：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 转述（后段两处：新来的工人照例 relays the water along the whole field，而母亲又一次 relayed the order to every boat）

answers.why: relay 意为“转述”，1989 年工头当着众人面转述把命令转达给每一条船，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 relayed。
relay 意为“转述”，自那以后工头一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 relays。
relay 意为“转述”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯转述把命令转达给每一条船”，此处为不定式 to relay the order to every boat。
relay 意为“转述”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人转述过，故用过去完成时 had relayed。
relay 意为“转述”，工头说“转述把命令转达给每一条船这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 relaying the order to every boat 作主语。
relay 意为“接力传送”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去接力传送让水顺着整块地接力流过”，should ever 之后用原形 relay the water along the whole field。
relay 意为“接力传送”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻接力传送让水顺着整块地接力流过（relay the water along the whole field at once），以后再也不要提起。
relay 意为“转述”，新来的工人每个班次都照例接力传送让水顺着整块地接力流过，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 relays。
relay 意为“转述”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面转述把命令转达给每一条船，用一般过去式 relayed 叙述。
relay 意为“转述”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要转述把命令转达给每一条船，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 relay 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the foreman relayed the order to every boat in public, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman relays the order to every boat in silence whenever the site asks.
Relaying the order to every boat in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever relay the water along the whole field in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site relays the water along the whole field in public every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother relayed the order to every boat again, and the site remembered that half.
